title: Spyglass: Now Generally Available with Enhanced Functionality
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, providing a robust suite of tools designed to deliver unparalleled insights and empower your decision-making.

title: Enhanced File Management
summary: Effortlessly manage, upload, and customize the display of your files directly within the editor for a more powerful content creation experience.

title: Introducing Our Public Roadmap
summary: We've launched a new public roadmap page where you can see what features we've shipped, what's coming next, and what's planned for the future, keeping you informed every step of the way.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Experience a more fluid and intuitive way to manage your tasks with our newly redesigned checkboxes, now bigger, easier to interact with, and fully draggable.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've significantly enhanced our real-time editor collaboration, making it easier and more intuitive to work together with clearer syncing and improved awareness of everyone's contributions.

title: Enhanced Collaboration and Discovery
summary: We've made it easier than ever to discover, view, and collaborate on important ideas and quests shared with you, boosting your collective productivity.

title: Unlock Noeko in Your Language
summary: Soon, Noeko will communicate with you in your preferred language, offering a truly global and inclusive experience.

title: Open Source Noeko
summary: We are making Noeko's software freely available and transparent to empower our community with maximum control, direct involvement in its evolution, and clear insight into our development journey.

title: Enhanced Constellation View
summary: Transform your Constellation view into a powerful workflow hub with advanced filtering for tags and time, plus clear visibility of all your shared content.

title: Dynamic Search Filters & Personalized Collections
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint and organize your essential knowledge with powerful filtering tools and the ability to save your custom searches for instant, focused access.

title: Enhanced Note Organization
summary: Experience a breakthrough in how you structure your ideas, with versatile new display modes that bring your connected notes to life and perfectly align with your thought process.

title: Noeko Self-Hosting & New Premium Plans
summary: Empower your team with greater control and access to advanced capabilities through Noeko's new self-hosting option and expanded premium plans.

title: A Fresh Look: Enhanced Themes & New Designs
summary: Prepare for a complete visual refresh with refined existing themes and an exciting array of new design choices for every preference.

title: Smarter, Time-Aware Greetings
summary: We're enhancing our app to greet you with the perfect time of day, ensuring a more personalized and seamless experience from the moment you log in.

title: Streamlined Tagged Item Management
summary: Take full control of your tagged content with new direct actions, enabling you to instantly unapply tags, delete items, or view details right from your lists.

title: Unlock Diverse Content Sources
summary: Effortlessly integrate and interact with a wider array of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and various text formats, to enrich your knowledge and insights directly within the platform.
